messages.subject: Referral by John Sellingsloh (UT Austin Student Interested in Banking @ Intrepid NY)
messages.body:
Hello Gary,

I hope you are doing well. I am an undergraduate Economics & Business
student at the University of Texas, and I'm pursuing a career in Investment
Banking. I had the privilege of speaking with John during Thursday's on
campus networking event; however, I didn't get a chance to meet you. I'd
love to talk to you to learn more about your experience at Intrepid given
I'm particularly interested in Banking in New York.

If you have any free time in the next week or so, it would be great to set
up a quick phone call with you. I am pretty open and can likely adjust my
schedule to accommodate whatever works best for you. Please let me know if
you would be willing to do this. Attached is my resume.

Best,
Jonathan

--
*Jonathan Nachman *
University of Texas, Austin
Economics & Business
M: (310)-292-4712
